messages:
alex: FYI NordEast flagged 24 H100s at FRA customs for a pallet weight mismatch. Landed 2024-07-08 09:00 CET, on hold. AWB 219-NE-7741.

maria: Those were for pool-bridge-2 eu-west-1 topup?

alex: Yep. If clearance delays >24h we miss q3 provisioning window.

liam: Customs usually wants weight cert or HS-code reclass. Any docs/photos?

alex: Vendor sent carrier note but no pallet photos. They say customs requested HS code clarification + weight cert + thermal packaging proof.

vendor-bot: Vendor: "FRA customs requested HS code clarification and weight certificate. Estimate 24-72h. Requesting insurer pre-approval for air-expedite."

sophie: If >24h trigger contingency: crossdock from AMS spare pool or air-expedite partial shipment. Which units are priority?

alex: 8 units are for a latency-critical customer rollout; 16 are pool buffer.

maria: Can we borrow EU refurb or swap from partner? Cost vs air-expedite?

liam: Air-expedite FRA->AMS ~€8k/unit. Crossdock truck from AMS spare pool ~€1.2k/unit but adds 18-24h.

sophie: 18-24h misses SLO. Recommend air-expedite for 8. Need finance for ~€64k.

maria: Vendor offered 50% brokerage credit if it's their fault. Ask for proof.

alex: Vendor uploaded updated invoice + preliminary weight cert. Customs still reviewing.

ops-bot: RMA-SPLIT created: RMA-2024-118. Split manifest, new AWB for expedite, insurer pre-approve. Assigned @maria @alex.

maria: Finance tentatively OK for €25k cost-share pending reconciliation. Need depot photos and manifest split when AWB issued.

liam: Sample carrier API call to split manifest:

POST /v1/shipments/split - { original_awb: "219-NE-7741", split_counts: [8,16], destinations: ["AMS_DEPOT","FRA_HOLD"] }

alex: Vendor sent AWB 219-NE-7741-A for the 8 expedite units. AeroSwift assigned.

vendor-bot: Update: FRA customs cleared 8 units at 13:12 CET after reclassification. Remaining 16 pending.

sophie: Tag expedited units "q3-priority-expedite" and pre-stage images/kv-cache for quick provisioning.

ops-bot: Pre-staging started on AMS rapid-provision pool. ETA 3h post pickup.

maria: Filing PM to add HS-code checklist + pallet photos requirement in vendor contract.

alex: Will update if vendor disputes cost-share or if remaining 16 clear. :thumbsup:
